_comment: ISOLATED bench graph -- arm C, FastWan 5B expressed as Kijai's rank-128 DMD LoRA over the INCUMBENT wan_ti2v Q5_K_M GGUF. API-prompt format, video stage ONLY. NOT otr_canonical.json and NOT wired into any engine; admitted by the CLAUDE.md s0A isolated-bench carve-out (O6) and pinned by SHA-256 in the campaign manifest. Base weights are BIT-IDENTICAL to arm A -- the axis under test is the distillation (LoRA) plus its 3-step DMD recipe, nothing else. RECIPE, pinned from the FastVideo code path and NOT from the model card: 3 steps at timesteps 1000/757/522 (sigmas 1.0/0.757/0.522 then 0), cfg 1.0, shift 5.0, euler is NOT used -- the transition is a full restart (predict x0, re-noise to the next timestep with FRESH noise, zero carry-over), which no stock ComfyUI sampler implements, hence OTR_DMDRestartSamplerSelect. Node 5 (negative) stays wired as a same-graph control and is documented EXECUTING BUT SAMPLER-INERT at cfg 1.0, which is also what upstream does. Shared bench controls otherwise identical to arm A: 832x480, seed 42, still c02_466a19906ccb.png, tiled decode 256/64/16/8, batch 1, CreateVideo fps 24.0. The runner sets ONLY length (per rung), the resolved model enums, and filename_prefix.
